title: yeasty crispy Moroccan Emmentaler cheese Khlea
description: A classic Moroccan dish featuring crispy Emmentaler cheese served with toasted bread, perfect for a comforting snack or breakfast.

ingredients.name: 4 cups all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: bread flour can be used for a more traditional taste

instructions: Combine yeast and warm water in a large bowl, let it sit for 5-10 minutes until frothy.
Add sugar to the bowl and stir to dissolve.
Add flour, salt, and melted butter to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap and let it rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 2 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a long rope and braid into 2 long braids.
Place the braids on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, brush with butter and sprinkle with parsley.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
Meanwhile toast the bread by grilling or baking at 350°F (180°C) for 5-7 minutes until crispy.
Brush the toasted bread with butter, sprinkle with Emmentaler cheese, garlic and Za'atar (if using).
Place the bread under the broiler for 1-2 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve warm with cheese bread and a side of braided bread.
